title: Hiring Offer Exception Review
core_conflict: A recruiter note says an offer can be sent immediately, while compensation and immigration evidence require an exception review before outreach.
required_constraints: include contradictory recruiter, compensation, and immigration evidence
include workspace files, email threads, task-board exception items, and offer-deadline calendar entries
include dynamic updates that change approval, equity, or immigration status after early rounds
emphasize policy exception handling, stakeholder reconciliation, and required email action
